subject: Quantum mechanics
hook: QUANTUM MECHANICS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Quantum mechanics isn’t limited to single atoms – it has been experimentally confirmed in complex molecules containing thousands of atoms, showing truly macroscopic quantum behavior
angle_support: "it has been demonstrated to hold for complex molecules with thousands of atoms"
"electrons, atoms, and molecules are all found to exhibit the same dual behavior when fired towards a double slit"
title: Quantum Mechanics is Everywhere, Not Just in Atoms
description: While many assume quantum behavior is confined to subatomic particles, experimental evidence confirms that large, complex molecules also follow these fundamental laws of nature.
narration: QUANTUM MECHANICS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture tiny subatomic particles behaving strangely. You assume these bizarre rules only apply to isolated atoms. It was closer to reality that they govern massive, complex structures. Experiments confirm that molecules containing thousands of individual atoms exhibit true quantum interference. These massive, complex systems reveal that wave-particle duality and entanglement are not restricted to the microscopic world. Size is not the final barrier. The laws of the very small rule the entire physical world.
